core_obligations: Statement (lines 277-281): every morphism of Delta is a composition of the morphisms delta^n_j and sigma^n_j.

Verification (proof lines 283-294): given phi: [n] -> [m], if j is not in the image of phi write phi = delta^m_j psi with psi: [n] -> [m-1]; if phi(j) = phi(j+1) write phi = psi sigma^{n-1}_j with psi: [n-1] -> [m]; each replacement strictly lowers n + m, so the process terminates at a map that is both injective and surjective, i.e. an identity.
proof_roadmap: Strip one missing value at a time using a coface.
Strip one collision at a time using a codegeneracy.
Termination by the strictly decreasing quantity n + m.
difficulty_reason: Delta generation (statement 277-281, proof 283-294): the stripping algorithm is fully explicit, including the termination argument; no step omitted. H3.
